source_title: JP Nadda On Health Capacity, AIIMS Expansion, Cancer Drug Prices And Opposition - India Today - India Today
source_excerpt:
At the India Today Group’s Health Wealth Summit 2026, Union Health Minister JP Nadda outlined India’s healthcare expansion, highlighting Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, digital health platforms ABHA and U-WIN, and wider disease screening. He said institutional deliveries had reached 90%, while maternal and infant mortality rates had declined. Nadda cited the expansion to 23 AIIMS and 860 medical colleges.
On healthcare funding, he said the Centre was prepared to raise public health expenditure to 2.5% of GDP but flagged states’ limited spending capacity and unutilised funds. He also highlighted cancer drug price caps, Jan Aushadhi and AMRIT pharmacies, and grievance redressal mechanisms under Ayushman Bharat, while criticising opposition protests.
